items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Sandy Dietrich-Bell, CEO of oneROOF Youth Services
notes:
Sandy Dietrich-Bell, CEO of oneROOF Youth Services delegated on concerns related to the security of the oneRoof Kitchener site as there has been an exponential increase of critical incidents involving off-site adults at the site since December 2022. She requested funding for full-time in-house security to mitigate incidents and maintain a good relationship with the residents and the community. 

In response to the Committee, S. Dietrich-Bell confirmed that she has discussed the issue with Regional Staff, Police, and the Staff at the former Kitchener Schwaben Club that is being used as a new emergency shelter location for people experiencing homelessness. She also confirmed that she submitted a proposal to Staff for four or five full-time oneROOF Youth Services Staff. 

P. Sweeney confirmed that the Region provides 24-hour security for any shelter site legally owned by the Region. He explained that there is currently no funding available to provide additional security for the neighbourhood surrounding these sites, however, the budget process still includes discussions with Regionally funded providers such as oneROOF. 

The Committee expressed the importance of identifying impacts on communities in proximity to these sites and to provide necessary supports. It was noted that there are additional needs when providing services to youths and that there needs to be a broader discussion on what security entails, specifically, the involvement of police services. The Committee also expressed concern regarding issues related to the Residential Tenancies Act. 

In response to the Committee. P. Sweeney confirmed that the former Kitchener Schwaben Club will continue to be a shelter site for 1.5 years.

The Committee directed Staff to review the urgent security concerns at all Regional shelter sites and the opportunity for security funding in the 2023 budget with consideration of potentially applicable community resources.

items.title: Strategic Focus – Healthy, Safe and Inclusive Communities
CSD-HOU-23-003, Interim Housing Solutions Implementation Update
notes:
The Committee acknowledged the efforts of Staff during the inclement weather during Christmas 2022.

Staff were directed to review the potential of extending warming center hours of operation and to conduct a debrief with area municipalities, to better coordinate efforts around the Region during inclement weather.

The report was provided for information.
